items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: That's the way Louis made this "St. Louis Blues." Ain't nobody but he and Fred Longshaw playing piano.

ctx.x: Vaudeville, yeah. He made some records with them, King Oliver did, with just nothing but him and the piano. That's the way Louis made this "St. Louis Blues." Ain't nobody but he and Fred Longshaw playing piano. Louis got a mute in it. That's the prettiest sound I think I ever heard in my life. It just drove me crazy to hear that.
